task_description:
Set up a structured collection for Traditional Chinese Medicine resources and clean up the duplicate “Work Projects” folder name:

1) Under the “Reading List” folder, create a new folder named “Traditional Chinese Medicine”. Inside it, create three subfolders named “Acupuncture”, “Herbal Medicine”, and “Research”.

2) Add the following bookmarks with appropriate metadata, ensuring each URL is valid and that no duplicate (same URL in the same folder) is created:
- Title: WHO Traditional Medicine Overview
  URL: https://www.who.int/health-topics/traditional-medicine
  Folder: Traditional Chinese Medicine (top-level, not a subfolder)
  Tags: tcm, reference
  Description: Global overview and policy framework on traditional medicine from WHO.
- Title: NCCIH: Acupuncture
  URL: https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/acupuncture
  Folder: Traditional Chinese Medicine > Acupuncture
  Tags: tcm, reference
  Description: Evidence, safety considerations, and practical information on acupuncture from NCCIH.
- Title: PubMed: TCM Herbal Formula RCTs
  URL: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Traditional+Chinese+Medicine+herbal+formula+randomized+controlled+trial
  Folder: Traditional Chinese Medicine > Research
  Tags: tcm, reference
  Description: Search results for randomized controlled trials of TCM herbal formulas on PubMed.

If the “tcm” tag does not already exist, create it and use it as specified above.

3) In the “Work Projects” hierarchy, rename the nested subfolder currently named “Work Projects” (the one under the top-level “Work Projects” folder) to “Design Resources”.

4) In the renamed “Design Resources” folder, update the “Figma Interface Guidelines” bookmark by removing the “urgent” tag, ensuring it keeps the “design” tag, and update its description to append: “ Useful for UI assets; organized under Design Resources.” If it is not already in the renamed folder, move it there.
